The Species tab gives you a starting body: human, elf, dwarf, orc, tiefling, animal folk and more. Pick one, then change anything you like.
Work across the tabs
Along the top: Body (height, weight, muscle), Face , Skin , Eyes , Hair , Clothes , Accessories (hats, horns, weapons, jewellery) and Wings & tail .
Drag the person to turn them round. Whole and Face , top right, zoom out and in.
Each change remakes you, which takes a second or two (it says Making you… ). Change a few things, then look.
Save me keeps it, and everyone sees you this way. Cancel throws the changes away; Use my old look goes back to how you were. Wings and tails cost gold the first time, then they are yours for good.
